units.source_text: 姐姐都是为了我才会订婚。

en.t: My sister became engaged entirely for my sake.

units.source_text: 即使你不承认，但是我心里明白。

en.t: Even if you will not admit it, I know it in my heart.

units.source_text: 我们一起去帝国剧院的那天晚上，姐姐问我是不是喜欢阿俊。

en.t: On the night we went to the Imperial Theater together, my sister asked me whether I liked A-Jun.

units.source_text: 你还对我说，假如我喜欢的话，姐姐一定会成全我，让我和阿俊结婚。

en.t: You also told me that if I liked him, you would surely help me and let me marry A-Jun.

units.source_text: 那时候，姐姐已经看过我写给阿俊的信了吧。

en.t: By then, you had already read the letter I wrote to A-Jun, had you not?

units.source_text: 找不到那封信的时候，我确实怨恨过姐姐。

en.t: When I could not find that letter, I really did resent you.

units.source_text: （很抱歉，只是这件事，我就充满了歉意。）

en.t: I am very sorry; for this matter alone, I am filled with remorse.

units.source_text: 因此，那天晚上姐姐对我亲切的话语，我一直觉得是嘲讽。

en.t: Because of that, I always felt that the kind words you spoke to me that night were meant as mockery.

units.source_text: 你必定还记得，那时候我还很愤怒，也没认真的回答。

en.t: You must still remember that I was very angry then and did not answer seriously.

units.source_text: 但是两三天之后，姐姐突然订婚了，

en.t: But two or three days later, you suddenly became engaged,

units.source_text: 那个时候我想即使是死，也要跟姐姐表达歉意，

en.t: and at that time I thought that even if it killed me, I had to apologize to you,

units.source_text: 因此我知道姐姐心里也喜欢阿俊。

en.t: so I knew that in your heart you liked A-Jun too.

units.source_text: （不要不承认，我看在眼里呢。）

en.t: Do not deny it; I saw it with my own eyes.

units.source_text: 姐姐如果不是照顾我的感受，必定会和阿俊结婚。

en.t: If you had not been considerate of my feelings, you would surely have married A-Jun.

units.source_text: 虽然这样，姐姐却反复跟我说，说你心里没有阿俊。

en.t: Even so, you kept telling me again and again that A-Jun was not in your heart.

units.source_text: 就这样，姐姐违背了自己的心意结婚了。

en.t: And so you married against your own heart.

units.source_text: 我心里最在意的姐姐啊！

en.t: Oh, my sister, the person dearest to my heart!

units.source_text: 你还记得吧，我今天把我养的鸡也带来了，让它也跟姐姐告别。

en.t: You remember, do you not, that today I even brought the chicken I raised, so it could say goodbye to you too.

units.source_text: 原本，我是想让我养的鸡和我自己一起跟姐姐致歉。

en.t: Originally, I wanted the chicken I raised and I myself to apologize to you together.

units.source_text: 但是，最后对此毫无察觉的妈妈也哭了。

en.t: But in the end, Mother, who had no idea about any of this, cried too.
